about.kitmode:
This is a kit for restoring your computer after reinstalling Windows.

It holds your folders, program settings and lists of what was installed. Press "Restore after reinstalling": you can choose "Just show" first - the program lists what it would do and changes nothing.

Restoring only adds and replaces files; nothing is ever deleted.
about.first:
Reinstall Kit collects everything needed to make your computer the same as it is now after you reinstall Windows: your folders, projects, program settings, the list of installed programs, schedules and keys.

Where to start
Press "Set up". The program scans the computer and suggests a list with checkboxes - remove what you do not need, add your own. Then choose where to keep the copy: preferably another drive or an external one.

After that the kit updates itself once a day.
about.intro: The kit is everything needed to make your computer the same as it is now after you reinstall Windows.
about.how: Only new and changed files are copied, so it usually takes a minute or two. Previous versions of changed and deleted files are kept in the kit's "_versions" folder for {0} days and are then removed automatically.
about.when.on: By itself, every day at {0} (if the computer was off - after it is switched on). You get a notification when the copy is made. The "Update the kit" button is only for when you want it right now.
about.when.off: Only when you press "Update the kit": the schedule is off.
about.h.not: WHAT IS NOT IN THE KIT
about.not:
•  The programs and games themselves - only their list is saved, and they are installed again from it.
•  Anything you did not tick in Set up.
•  Windows system settings: where profile folders live, the page file and the like are only written down for reference.
